    Category 11 (Gabriel–Roiter 10.7) is representation-infinite #

    The orientation of BO13a figure 6.7: a commutative square x → p → s, x → q → s with an arm r → p into the square, and arms x → t, q → c out of it. As a core poset: core x ≤ p, q, source r ≤ p, sinks s (above p, q), t (above x), c (above q).
